name: 비형
motion_summary: Eternal Return Bihyung Let's Have Some Fun: green hair, red small horns, sharp playful red eyes NO GLASSES, traditional/modern black-white-red outfit and enormous dark spiked goblin club exactly per reference. R leaps, wears dokkaebi invisibility hat, grows large and slams ground. 12 frames ready; squat with club; spring upward; airborne raise small traditional dokkaebi cap in free hand; put cap on head (do NOT hide eyes); body grows to 125% size while airborne, still inside cell; lift club overhead; plunge; strong ground slam with cyan/green ghost-fire circular shock, eyes clear; giant stance with small goblin flame motes; cap removed and shrink back; ready. Size change intentional ONLY for R growth, camera/floor fixed. Use actual hand/club/body movement, not a static aura. No other characters/spirits with faces. Landscape4:3, 4×3 equal square cells, generous 15% margin even giant frame.
